Спред-дюрация

A measure of a bond portfolio’s sensitivity to changes in credit spreads; it quantifies the impact of spread changes on the value of the portfolio, holding interest rates constant.

Definition

A measure of a bond portfolio’s sensitivity to changes in credit spreads; it quantifies the impact of spread changes on the value of the portfolio, holding interest rates constant.

Operational example

An increase in spread duration exposes the portfolio to greater credit spread risk, especially in volatile credit markets.

Localized term

Спред-дюрация

Localized example

Увеличение спред-дюрации увеличивает подверженность портфеля кредитному риску спреда, особенно на волатильных рынках.
